title: 第97章 放心，一切尽在掌控！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚大结局全文免费阅读
content_zh: 然而面对宁川的控诉，唐逸和萧棣下巴一样，异口同声道：“放心，一切尽在掌控中。”我掌控你大爷！宁川差点爆粗口，指了指身后。“除了丞相外，整个大炎的领导层几乎都在这里了。”“两位爷，这要是出现意外，大炎可就完了啊！”听到这话，唐逸和萧棣看向他的目光，就像是在看个白痴。两人不约而同抬手拍了拍宁川的肩膀，唐逸语重心长道：“所以，不会出现意外，宁头，不要一叶障目，把该干的事干好就行。”“剩下的，交给我们。”说完，两人挎着绣春刀离开了。宁川看着两人的背影，气得差点捶胸顿足，谁一叶障目了？真出了事，背锅的是老子啊！“老大，你也别太担心了，不是还有御前司配合吗？”林豹看到自家老大一副要拔刀砍人的样子，走过来说道：“我看到御前司的高手，都混在了宾客中，应该问题不大。”“没有问题？你们对暗京楼一无所知。”宁川拂袖，脸色难看。没有人比他更清楚暗京楼的恐怖。这些年，他大大小小和暗京楼交手数十次，没有一次讨到便宜，全都付出惨重的代价收尾。三年前，幽州刺史买通暗京楼，暗杀前往幽州调查军饷贪墨案的钦差大臣，他奉命协助锦衣卫三处保护钦差，结果钦差还是被刺身亡，负责保护的锦衣卫几乎全军覆没。加上幽州刺史叛乱，整个幽州城血流成河，几乎成了一座鬼蜮。两年前，有乡绅买通暗金楼，谋杀勤政爱民的安定县县令。还是他们奉命保护，虽然杀了暗京楼的杀手，但也惹怒了暗京楼，出动数十个高手，几乎血洗了半个县！那群狗曰的，只准他们杀人，不准人反抗的。今日大炎位高权重的人都在这里了，他们不会错过这种机会，杀皇帝，绑架大炎满朝文武，威震天下！他们会错过这种机会？！“呃，头，要不，你去劝一下陛下？”林豹委屈，你冲我发火也没用啊！我就是个打杂的。宁川想到炎文帝那张脸，算了，惹不起。皇帝都不急，他……好吧，他急，那是他十族啊！虽然有前身的记忆，但进入沈园之后，唐逸还是有些震惊的。作为京都最大的园林，这里不仅风景秀丽，而且极为广阔，能同时容纳上万人。而沈家的诗会，是在沈园的鹿鸣湖上。这是专为贵族宴会而修建场所，男女分席，男子在左，女子在右边，中间由一个小型湖泊隔开。而在湖面上，建有一个舞台，便是今日参加宴会的青年才俊展示才华的地方。唐逸打着哈欠扫了一圈，看到杜凌菲和唐音正冲着自己招手。他笑了笑，便迈步向着舞台走了过去。“怎么？你也要参加比试？”唐逸看到萧棣跟着自己走上舞台，睨着他问道。“不比，我怕比试的人中有暗京楼的人，把你给宰了。”萧棣抱着剑，嘴里叼着草根，痞里痞气。娶孔诗岚，那是不可能的，以孔家在京都的底蕴，他真娶了孔诗岚，他那几个兄长肯定睡不好觉，想方设法搞死他。唐逸想想也是，就他现在这糟糕的身体，近战搏杀那是找死。“行吧，那我就准许你暂时跟在我身边，不过你的狗脾气收敛点，不到万不得已不要动手……当然，刺客除外。”唐逸警告萧棣。就这货的暴脾气，能动手绝不哔哔，等下要是被人点了几句，说不定得当场爆炸。他还要将太子拉下马，让这家伙上去坐坐太子的位置呢。今日要是在百官面前行凶，肯定会留下很不好的印象……好吧，现在百官对这家伙，也没有啥好印象就是了。萧棣睨着唐逸，喂，搞清楚状况好吗？什么叫你准许我在身边？有老子保护，你该感恩戴德。但很快，萧棣的怒火就转移了。他跟着唐逸上了舞台，结果除了杜凌菲和唐音外，全场愣是没有一束目光落在他们身上。焦点全都在唐画身上。此时，那家伙正嘴角含笑，谦和儒雅和一众参加比试的学子才子闲谈，俨然一副年轻一辈的领袖一样。看得萧棣一阵火大，很想将这虚伪的混账按在地上打一顿。“我说，你就一点都不生气？这货肯定又在编排你。”萧棣斜眸瞥唐逸，拱火。唐逸却坐在身侧的围栏上，打着哈欠，一副没睡醒的样子。“急什么？这才刚刚开始而已。”唐逸丝毫不在意，道：“这要是就生气了，那我等下还不得被气死？”他随意扫了一下，只见无数少女看着唐画的眼睛都在冒着小星星，很多男人更是对他羡慕嫉妒恨。英俊潇洒温文尔雅还三元及第，简直就是男神中的男神……不过，可惜是假的，这等下要是遮羞布被扯下来了，不知道他们的脸色会何等精彩。萧棣抱着绣春刀，一时间没搞清楚唐逸话中的意思。这时，女人那边传来了议论声。“唐夫人，恭喜啊，令郎气定神闲，看来今日这头筹必定属于唐大少了。”“唐画这孩子谦谦君子，的确不凡，三元及第，这是多少人梦寐以求却求而不得的事。”“这一次唐画夺得第一，必定获得陛下赐婚，到时候孔唐两家联姻，有孔家的支持，唐画未来不可限量啊！”“嗯？那穿着飞鱼服的，就是唐家四少吧？怎么一副无精打采的样子？”“哼，这种庄严的场合，竟然这么没规矩，丢人现眼。”“……”听到这群女人的话，萧棣错愕看向唐逸，原来你早有先见之明啊！“淡定，这还只是开始而已。”唐逸耸耸肩。这才哪到哪？真正的唇枪舌剑的交锋还没开始呢！人群中，众星捧月的颜霜玉听着众人对唐画的夸赞，整个人都快飘起来了。以前你们对我爱答不理，现在还不是乖乖对我各种恭维？“大家客气了，比试还没有开始呢，谁输谁赢还不好说。”颜霜玉看向舞台，目光落在角落打着哈欠的唐逸身上，道：“像我家小逸，那也是个顶好的儿郎，也是文采风流英俊潇洒的。”一群女人顺着颜霜玉的目光看去，看到没有睡醒无精打采的唐逸，脸色都不由怪异起来，这就是你说的英俊潇洒？姜云娜看着唐画，眼中爱意早已泛滥成灾。现在见到唐逸，当时嗤笑一声道：“伯母，你也太抬举他了，就他？给画哥哥提鞋，我都嫌弃他手脏。”姜云娜目光落在唐逸身上，冷笑。让你身败名裂的方法有无数种，搭上自身清誉诬陷你，只是最低级的一种。现在，就让你看看，女人的嘴，是怎么杀人无形的。见到将一群女人的目光吸引了过来，姜云娜眼一眨，眼睛渐红。“诸位姐姐，你们有所不知，唐逸为了娶孔家大小姐，简直卑鄙无耻。”“她不仅各种抹黑和诬陷三元及第的兄长，还暗中花钱买了好几首诗词。”“什么风采风流，全是装出来的！”
content_en: However, in the face of Ning Chuan's accusation, Tang Yi and Xiao Di said in unison: "Don't worry, everything is under control." I control you, uncle!Ning Chuan almost cursed and pointed behind him."Except for the prime minister, almost the entire leadership of Dayan is here." "Two gentlemen, if something unexpected happens, Dayan will be doomed!" After hearing this, Tang Yi and Xiao Di looked at him as if they were looking at an idiot.The two of them raised their hands and patted Ning Chuan on the shoulder. Tang Yi said seriously: "So, there will be no accidents. Ning Tou, don't blind your eyes with a leaf. Just do what you need to do." "Leave the rest to us." After saying that, the two left with Xiuchun Dao.Ning Chuan looked at the backs of the two of them and was so angry that he almost beat his chest and feet. Who was blinded by a leaf?If something goes wrong, I will be the one to take the blame!"Boss, don't worry too much. Don't you still have the Gozensi to cooperate?" Lin Bao saw his boss looking like he was about to draw a sword and kill someone, so he came over and said, "I saw that the masters of the Gozensi were all mixed in with the guests. It shouldn't be a big problem." "No problem? You know nothing about Anjing Tower." Ning Chuan fluttered his sleeves and looked ugly.No one knows the horror of Anjing Tower better than him.Over the years, he has fought against An Jinglou dozens of times, and he has never gained any advantage. They all ended at a heavy price.Three years ago, the governor of Youzhou bribed An Jinglou to assassinate the imperial envoy who went to Youzhou to investigate the military salary embezzlement case. He was ordered to assist the three Jinyiwei Divisions to protect the imperial envoy. However, the imperial envoy was assassinated and the entire Jinyiwei army responsible for protecting him was almost wiped out.Coupled with the rebellion of the governor of Youzhou, the entire Youzhou City was filled with blood and almost turned into a ghost.Two years ago, a squire bribed the dark gold building and murdered the magistrate of Anding County who was diligent and caring for the people.They were ordered to protect them. Although they killed Anjinglou's killers, they also angered Anjinglou. They sent out dozens of masters and bloodbathed almost half of the county!What those dogs said was that they were only allowed to kill, and no one was allowed to resist.Today, all the high-ranking people in Dayan are here. They will not miss this opportunity to kill the emperor, kidnap the civil and military officials of Dayan, and shock the world!Will they miss this opportunity?!"Uh, sir, why don't you go and persuade His Majesty?" Lin Bao felt aggrieved. It's useless for you to get angry at me!I'm just a handyman.Ning Chuan thought of Emperor Yanwen's face, forget it, he couldn't afford to offend him.The emperor is not in a hurry, he... well, he is in a hurry, that is his ten clans!Although he had memories of his previous life, Tang Yi was still a little shocked after entering Shen Garden.As the largest garden in Kyoto, it not only has beautiful scenery, but is also extremely vast and can accommodate tens of thousands of people at the same time.The Shen family's poetry meeting was held on Luming Lake in Shen Garden.This is a place specially built for noble banquets. Men and women sit separately, with men on the left and women on the right, separated by a small lake in the middle.On the lake, there is a stage where the young talents attending the banquet today will show off their talents.Tang Yi yawned and looked around, seeing Du Lingfei and Tang Yin waving at him.He smiled and walked towards the stage."What? You want to take part in the competition too?" Tang Yi asked as he saw Xiao Di following him onto the stage."No, I'm afraid that among the contestants there are people from Anjing Tower who will kill you." Xiao Di held the sword in his hand and held the grass root in his mouth, looking snarky.It was impossible to marry Kong Shilan. With the Kong family's background in Kyoto, if he really married Kong Shilan, his brothers would definitely not be able to sleep well and would try their best to kill him.Tang Yi thought about it. With his current poor body, fighting in close combat would be courting death."Okay, then I will allow you to stay with me for the time being, but please temper your temper and don't do anything unless absolutely necessary...except for assassins, of course." Tang Yi warned Xiao Di.This guy has such a bad temper that he won't beep even if he can get his hands dirty. If someone picks him up a few times later, he might explode on the spot.He also wants to pull the prince off his horse and let this guy get up and take the prince's seat.If he commits a crime in front of hundreds of officials today, it will definitely leave a very bad impression... Well, now the officials don't have a good impression of this guy.Xiao Di looked at Tang Yi and said, "Hey, can you figure out the situation?"What do you mean by allowing me to be around?You should be grateful for my protection.But soon, Xiao Di's anger shifted.He followed Tang Yi onto the stage, but except for Du Lingfei and Tang Yin, no one in the audience fell on them.The focus is all on Tang Hua.At this time, the guy was smiling, modest and elegant, chatting with the students and talents participating in the competition, just like a leader of the younger generation.Xiao Di was so angry that he wanted to knock this hypocritical bastard to the ground and give him a beating."I said, you're not angry at all? This guy must be setting you up again." Xiao Di glanced sideways at Tang Yi, angered.Tang Yi was sitting on the fence beside him, yawning and looking like he hadn't woken up."Why are you anxious? This is just the beginning." Tang Yi didn't care at all and said: "If you are angry now, then I will be angry to death later?" He glanced at it casually and saw that countless girls looked at Tang Hua with stars in their eyes, and many men were even more envious and jealous of him.Handsome, gentle, elegant, and ranked third, he is simply a god among male gods... However, it is a pity that it is fake. If the fig leaf is torn off later, I don't know how wonderful their faces will be.Xiao Di held the Xiuchundao and didn't understand the meaning of Tang Yi's words for a while.At this time, there was discussion from the woman's side."Mrs. Tang, congratulations. Your son is calm and relaxed. It seems that today's prize must belong to Young Master Tang." "This kid from Tang Hua is a humble gentleman. He is indeed extraordinary. He got the third prize. This is something that many people dream of but can't get." "This time Tang Hua wins the first place and will definitely get a marriage from His Majesty. When the time comes for the marriage between the Kong and Tang families, there will be a marriage between the Kong family and the Kong family.With your support, Tang Hua's future is limitless!" "Huh?Is that the fourth young master of the Tang family?" "Humph, it's so disrespectful to see such a solemn occasion." "..." After hearing what these women said, Xiao Di looked at Tang Yi in surprise. It turns out you had some foresight!"Calm down, this is just the beginning." Tang Yi shrugged.Where is this?The real verbal confrontation has not yet begun!In the crowd, Yan Shuangyu, who was surrounded by stars, felt like she was floating as she listened to the crowd's praise of Tang Hua.You used to be indifferent to me, but now you are obedient and give me all kinds of compliments?"Everyone
title_en: Chapter 97 Don’t worry, everything is under control!
